claims.statement: Verify note01 and source parts of notes02-04 against original L07/L08/L09 PDFs at precise locators. Check L07 distinct real exponents, lambda>-1/p, exact full-Muntz summation and any lower-density hypotheses used in its separate Sobolev statement; distinguish enlarged monomial span from difference-family span. Check Shen boundary conditions, finite-band formula/normalization and the generic Robin variational boundary-term caution. Verify Adcock-Huybrechs strict Gram cutoff and sqrt(epsilon) bound, distinguish their infinite frame premises from the independently reproved finite result. Versions are author/arXiv copies, not assumed identical publisher full texts.

Independently verify T1-T4 of note02 for arbitrary finite synthesis including dependent and zero columns, complex first-variable-linear convention, Gram entries/adjoint, equality discarded at threshold, coefficient estimates, moment noise versus perturbations to f, synthesis cutoff tau versus Gram epsilon=tau squared, and relative threshold/zero-map cases. Check true s2/s4 Krein-domain membership is required and exact-Gram scope excludes unanalysed quadrature errors.

Verify all L1-L4 of note03: integration operator norm constants, endpoint traces and finite Legendre recurrence including smallest indices; actual s2 coupled-domain lift/decomposition and polynomial span; s4 four low lifts and boundary/derivative traces, domain equality and span; every explicit degree-independent lower/upper Riesz constant at fixed c and completeness for complex coefficients; graph-Gram sparsity including finite low coupling; exact coefficient-tail and polynomial rate assumptions plus transfer to TSVD. Riesz status belongs only to replacement systems and is not uniform as c approaches zero. Check current sparse members are not asserted to belong to Hc4.

Verify D0-D10 of note04. Check genuine Kc image coefficients, complex moment conjugation and exact parity unitaries/weighted exponent shifts. Prove both directions of the claimed arithmetic-progression trace closure using actual cutoff, transformed derivative generators, endpoint residuals and correct topology; no monomial-to-difference shortcut. For reciprocal-summable parity sets check the enlarged exponent set satisfies all L07 integrability hypotheses after deduplication, construct a genuine nonzero L2 annihilator and pull back with true Kc inverse, keeping selected index sets separate from actual membership in a closed space. Verify explicit arithmetic/dyadic examples and the full continuous polynomial-functional criterion D10. Divergence for arbitrary nonarithmetic sets remains undecided; no general iff theorem may be implied.

Check all four proposed cards preserve proof hypotheses/status. Inspect exact/numerical checker and 250-check record, independently execute or recompute meaningful checks. The source project is immutable; to run check_author_results.py, copy it unmodified into a new temporary project with private/checks subdirectories because it writes beneath parents[2]. Record actual execution separately from analytic proof. Finite Gram spectra/dimensions support finite identities only and cannot prove the uniform bounds or infinite density statements. No Lean verification is claimed.
